infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MERA requires camera access to display the live preview and record talking-head videos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MERA requires microphone access to record high-quality audio and synchronize script teleprompting to your speech.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: MERA uses speech recognition to synchronize the teleprompter scrolling with your natural speaking voice.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MERA requires photo library access to browse and save your recorded videos locally.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: MERA needs permission to save completed recordings to your device photo library.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow MERA to access your camera to record videos and frame your shots.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow MERA to access your microphone for video audio and speech tracking.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow MERA to save your recordings to your photo library.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow MERA to save your recordings to your gallery.
